description:
Free, open source AI co-host for streamers that runs on your PC and speaks Spanish and English.

OpenCohost is a free, open source AI co-host for streamers. Its character, Kira, runs locally with Ollama models (optional cloud providers), speaks Spanish and English with Piper or Edge-TTS voices, shows a VRM avatar, and talks through the topics you queue in agenda mode. Open beta; Ollama is installed separately.
